import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def af(acc):
    m=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=60).json()[0]
    pdb=requests.get(m["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
    rows=[(l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),float(l[60:66]))
          for l in pdb.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM")]
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["aname","res","resi","x","y","z","b"])
Dh=af("Q1L5Z9")
def CA(D,lo,hi):
    s=D[(D.aname=="CA")&(D.resi>=lo)&(D.resi<=hi)].sort_values("resi"); return s[["x","y","z"]].values
def lig(D,ri):
    s=D[D.resi==ri]; rn=s.res.iloc[0]
    nm={"CYS":["SG"],"HIS":["NE2"]}.get(rn,["CB"])
    return s[s.aname.isin(nm)][["x","y","z"]].values[0]
def kab(P,Q):
    pm,qm=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);Pc,Qc=P-pm,Q-qm
    V,S,W=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc);d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W));R=V@np.diag([1,1,d])@W
    return (lambda X:(X-pm)@R+qm), float(np.sqrt((((Pc@R)-Qc)**2).sum(1).mean()))
T,rms=kab(CA(Dh,449,474), CA(Dh,143,168))

# 2-D projection onto the two principal axes of the superposed core (honest orthographic view)
core=CA(Dh,143,168); c0=core.mean(0)
U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(core-c0); ax1,ax2=Vt[0],Vt[1]
proj=lambda X: np.c_[(X-c0)@ax1,(X-c0)@ax2]

PN=proj(CA(Dh,134,196)); PC=proj(T(CA(Dh,440,492)))
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,5.2))
a=axes[0]
a.plot(*PN.T,color="#d95f02",lw=1.7,label="LONRF2 N-module 134-196")
a.plot(*PC.T,color="#1b9e77",lw=1.7,alpha=0.8,label="LONRF2 C-RING 440-492, superposed")
for ri in (143,146,163,166):
    p=proj(lig(Dh,ri)[None])[0]; a.scatter(*p,color="#d95f02",s=55,ec="k",zorder=5)
for ri,lb in [(158,"Cys158"),(160,"Leu160"),(190,"Cys190"),(195,"Cys195")]:
    p=proj(lig(Dh,ri)[None])[0]; a.scatter(*p,color="#e41a1c",s=60,marker="X",ec="k",zorder=5)
    a.annotate(lb,p,fontsize=8,xytext=(4,4),textcoords="offset points",color="#b2182b")
z1=proj(np.array([lig(Dh,r) for r in (143,146,163,166)]).mean(0)[None])[0]
a.scatter(*z1,color="#555",s=260,marker="*",ec="k",zorder=6); a.annotate("Zn site I\n(intact)",z1,fontsize=8.5,xytext=(6,-18),textcoords="offset points")
z2=proj(np.array([T(lig(Dh,r)[None])[0] for r in (464,466,483,486)]).mean(0)[None])[0]
a.scatter(*z2,color="#1b9e77",s=260,marker="*",ec="k",zorder=6)
a.annotate("Zn site II of the C-RING;\nin the N-module this pocket\nholds Leu156/Cys158/Leu160",z2,fontsize=8,xytext=(-150,-45),textcoords="offset points",color="#1b7a5a")
a.set_title(f"N-module on its own C-RING: Ca RMSD {rms:.2f} A over 26 core residues",fontsize=10)
a.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="lower right"); a.set_xlabel("PC1 (A)"); a.set_ylabel("PC2 (A)"); a.set_aspect("equal")

a=axes[1]
ris=[143,146,158,160,163,166,190,195]; labs=["Cys143","Cys146","Cys158","Leu160","Cys163","Cys166","Cys190","Cys195"]
P=np.array([lig(Dh,r) for r in ris]); M=np.sqrt(((P[:,None]-P[None])**2).sum(-1))
im=a.imshow(M,cmap="magma_r",vmin=3,vmax=24)
a.set_xticks(range(8));a.set_xticklabels(labs,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
a.set_yticks(range(8));a.set_yticklabels(labs,fontsize=8)
for i in range(8):
    for j in range(8): a.text(j,i,f"{M[i,j]:.1f}",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=6.6,color="white" if M[i,j]>14 else "black")
a.set_title("Ligand-atom distances in the\nhuman LONRF2 N-module (A)",fontsize=10)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=a,fraction=0.046)

a=axes[2]
names=["LONRF2\nhuman","LONRF2\nmouse","LONRF2\nanole","LONRF2\nquail","LONRF2\nmedaka","LONRF1\nhuman","LONRF3\nhuman","LONRF2\nC-RING","RNF4\nRING"]
vals=[1,1,2,2,2,2,2,2,2]
a.bar(range(9),vals,color=["#e41a1c","#e41a1c"]+["#4daf4a"]*7)
a.set_xticks(range(9)); a.set_xticklabels(names,fontsize=7.5)
a.set_yticks([0,1,2]); a.set_ylabel("zinc sites detected (max pairwise <= 6 A)")
a.set_title("Zinc sites per RING module in AlphaFold models\n(left 7 = N-terminal modules; right 2 = controls)",fontsize=9.5)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): a.text(i,v+0.04,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=9)
fig.suptitle("Human LONRF2 keeps the RING fold and zinc site I in its N-terminal module but has lost zinc site II",fontsize=12.5)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,0.93]); plt.show()
print("Ca RMSD core superposition:",round(rms,2))
